summary: Brother starts with an L hand at the forehead (the male spot) and brings it down to rest on the other index finger. Male plus same.
handshape: L hand moving to index fingers together
location: Forehead, then in front of chest
movement: L at the forehead drops to land on the other index finger
steps: Make an L handshape and touch the thumb to your forehead.
Bring the hand down and land the index finger on your other index finger.
mistakes: Starting at the chin. That's SISTER.
